commandRunner_comment: `bun test src`, not `bun test`. Mutation runs in a sandbox: a copy of this
package alone, instrumented sources, a moved cwd. A test that depends on
anything but the mutated code: a neighbouring manifest, the repo layout,
the transpiler: fails there and nowhere else, so the run is restricted to
the tests that live next to the mutated code. Root tests still run under
`bun test` and in CI; they simply kill no mutant.
timeout_comment: 5 s, not 30: three unbounded loops here (flushTemplates, fragment-runner,
create-stream) produce mutants that saturate the microtask queue without ever
reaching the macrotask queue: no setTimeout fires there, and the mutant holds
a core for the whole `timeoutMS`. The suite runs in ~250 ms. Concurrency 2
keeps the machine usable during the measurement.
